from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
path = root / "tests/control_center/test_control_center.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("cc_tests", path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
assert spec.loader is not None
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

checks = [
    (11, "ACTIVE_ONLY_AND_ALERT", "test_multisession_task_index_only_exposes_active_and_alerts_recent_failures"),
    (12, "GIT_SYNC_GREEN", "test_git_sync_green_when_production_main_matches_fetched_main"),
    (13, "GIT_SYNC_RED", "test_git_sync_red_on_production_divergence_or_dirty_tree"),
    (14, "DUTCH_UI", "test_owner_ui_is_dutch_but_canonical_codes_remain"),
]

for code, label, name in checks:
    suite = unittest.TestSuite([mod.ControlCenterTests(name)])
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=sys.stdout, verbosity=1).run(suite)
    if not result.wasSuccessful():
        print(f"CONTROL_CENTER_CLASSIFY_FAIL={label}", flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(code)

print("CONTROL_CENTER_CLASSIFY_PASS=ALL_NEW_TESTS", flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0)
